necessary_context.content: M is a finite-dimensional complete Riemannian manifold with sectional curvature bounded below by kappa<0. f:M->R union {+infinity} is proper, convex and lower semicontinuous. Its domain is weakly convex; convexity is along every domain-contained geodesic segment. For p in dom f, partial f(p) consists of tangent vectors s satisfying f(q)>=f(p)+<s,gamma'(0)> for every q in dom f and every domain-contained geodesic gamma:[0,1]->M joining p to q. Norms are Riemannian tangent norms; d is Riemannian distance. Nonempty subdifferentials are asserted at interior domain points.
necessary_context.name: Standing geometric and convex-analysis definitions

necessary_context.content: Omega*=argmin f is nonempty; f*=inf f; p0 is in int dom f; d0=dist(p0,Omega*)>0. Algorithm 1 uses Strategy 2 with 0<alpha<2 tanh(sqrt(abs(kappa))*d0)/(sqrt(abs(kappa))*d0). The paper assumes the generated sequence is well-defined and infinite. Lemma 4 selects qbar in Omega* with d(p0,qbar)=d0.
